title: Walk Out Lip Sync
eyebrow: GPOM scene C · lip-sync pass, 18 Nov
heading: The walk out: pick the best lip sync per line
intro: Same method as the toilet row: new talking clips, every voice take fitted whole to every clip, ranked by how many words land inside film's lip-sync tolerance (45 ms early to 125 ms late). Derek's clips k-n wrote his pause as an action; his takes were also re-voiced with longer pauses. Pick the one that sounds most like the character as well as the one in time; 'Now in the film' keeps it.

sections.lede: Sandra and Derek walking out over the downs.
